arms.color_swap: Both candidate owners on each of 16 exact roots versus unchanged Unit-board/Unit-hand, no-dynamic Unit-order foe; candidate and foe budgets are identical.

changed_premise: The preceding board-only 530201-530208 panel used only four-ply roots, so candidate owner 0 was always first to move and owner was confounded with first/reply role. This fresh cohort alternates three- and four-ply roots within every rule; each color is candidate-first on one parity and replying on the other. No outcome pooling. Seed feasibility is screened before outcomes: only exact ongoing 3/4-ply roots are accepted, so this cohort is conditional on that limited playability filter.

contrasts.unknowns: Independently bound every UNKNOWN reward in each paired contrast by [-1,+1]; report pooled, owner, first/reply, owner-by-role and seed strata. Keep paired roots and full histories.
contrasts.role: Derive first/reply from the candidate owner and the exact root side-to-move, not from color labels.

cost.expected: Under four minutes based on the completed 64-game single-process D3 panel (225.453 seconds); hard cap 2400 seconds.
cost.cheaper_alternative: A replay-only role-label calculation cannot identify outcome sensitivity; this is the smallest 64-slot design that balances the two colors across both root-side-to-move roles.

decision: Compare treatment bounds by owner and by candidate-first/reply strata. A pattern that changes by role rather than color is only descriptive finite-sample role association because three- and four-ply roots also differ in state. Do not retain the board-only candidate as owner-robust unless all-owner and all first/reply conservative lower bounds are strictly positive and the paired median-node cost gate passes. No population, causal role, price law, global default or strength claim.
integrity: No training, solver, auxiliary checkout, outcome pooling or product/default changes.
Both arms and fixed foe use Unit hand values, no optional dynamic/spatial/compact terms, and Unit ordering.
Use fresh seeds, three/four-ply roots, D3/8192-node/0.5-second/q0/TT0/root-window-off budgets; preserve outcomes, UNKNOWNs, promotions, drops, full histories, work counts and wall costs.
question: In a fresh 5x5 D3 sample with three- and four-ply roots balanced across candidate colors, does the board-only treatment pattern align more with candidate-first/reply role or with color owner?

roots.terminal_prefixes: For this panel require every planned 3/4-ply root to remain ongoing after exactly the requested prefix; if any selected root fails, abort before games and revise the plan. No terminal or short roots are silently included.
roots.selection: Each rule has one three-ply family root (side 1 moves first when the full prefix is legal) and one four-ply family root (side 0 moves first). Both candidate colors are played on each exact root.

rules.selection: Candidate seeds were scanned in ascending order before any outcome run. Reject only a seed whose deterministic 3- or 4-ply prefix is already terminal before the exact planned root; assign setup/movement configs by accepted slot index. Rejected 530307 at slot6 and 530309 at slot7; accept 530308 and 530310. Then rebuild and replay every outcome. This feasibility filter is not an outcome-based replacement.
